description: This file implements an LLM Guard integration for content moderation, including a class '_ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard' with methods for moderation checks, pre-call hooks, and post-call streaming hooks, utilizing external libraries such as aiohttp and fastapi.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LLMGuard
classes.description: A class providing content moderation via an external LLM Guard API, with methods for checking content, deciding whether to proceed with requests, and handling moderation hooks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LLM Guard with optional mock testing and redacted text, sets API base URL from secrets.

methods.name: moderation_check
methods.description: Performs content moderation by calling the external API and raises HTTPException if content is invalid.

methods.name: should_proceed
methods.description: Determines if moderation should proceed based on mode and permissions.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook that performs moderation check based on call type and data.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_hook
methods.description: Performs moderation check on streaming responses.
